Offers by the IMPRS-QD
Numerous tutorials and special topical seminars (funding for guest lecturers for tutorials subject to the approval of the IMPRS-QD Executive Board).
Yearly events: usually workshop or excursion.
Funding for living expenses (subject to the approval of the full IMPRS-QD Board) and visits of other laboratories (subject to the approval of the IMPRS-QD Executive Board). Please find further information here.
Support for participation in conferences and summer/winter schools (subject to the approval of the IMPRS-QD Executive Board). Please check the conditions here.
